name: Marco Ibarra
call_notes: Marco said a chilled-water line leaked over a weekend last spring and nobody noticed until Monday. Two lithography tools were down for nine days. He now walks the sub-fab himself every Friday because the building alarms only cover the main floor.

name: Tom Reinholt
call_notes: Tom manages two fabs. His biggest worry is water from roof drains and HVAC condensate reaching tools. Insurance covered only part of the last incident. He wants earlier warnings, not more reports.

name: Kevin Mbeki
call_notes: Kevin checks particle counter logs every morning by exporting spreadsheets from three systems. Excursions are often found hours after they start. He said HVAC filter changes cause most spikes.

name: Raj Kulkarni
call_notes: Raj said the particle counters work fine but nobody connects counts to what was happening in the room. Root-cause reviews take a full week because data sits in separate tools.

name: Dr. Elise Fournier
call_notes: Elise runs a shared cleanroom with over 200 student users. Students forget gowning steps and contamination is hard to trace to a person or time. Her monitoring budget was cut this year.

name: Julia Brenner
org: Cornell NanoScale Science and Technology Facility

name: Michael Tanaka
call_notes: Michael spends about two days before every audit pulling environmental monitoring records into one report. Missing data points have led to audit findings twice. He wants a report he can trust without rebuilding it.

name: Victor Santos
call_notes: Victor said deviation reports are written by hand after each excursion. The cleanroom team and QA argue about when an excursion actually started because timestamps differ between systems.

name: Luis Romero
call_notes: Luis said most of his week is reacting to tool alarms. He has no warning before a pump or chiller fails, and spare parts take ten days to arrive.

name: Derek Lindqvist
call_notes: Derek tracks tool health in a personal spreadsheet. When he is on vacation nobody else checks it. Last year a vacuum pump failure scrapped a full lot of wafers.

name: Ethan Park
call_notes: Ethan said he logs particle readings on paper during his shift and types them in later. He is not sure who reviews them.

name: Zoe Adeyemi
call_notes: Zoe said her experiments were ruined twice by contamination she found out about only after results came back.
